nodes.description: Timestamp of the last inflation supply mint event; read by weeksSinceLastIssuance() and isMintable() to compute elapsed time.
Counter of weeks since the start of supply inflation; read in mintableSupply() and written in recordMintEvent().
Amount of PERI rewarded to the caller of PeriFinance.mint(); only mutable through setMinterReward().
Address of the PeriFinance proxy; used for the onlyPeriFinance modifier and for the IERC20 external totalSupply() call.
Constant initial weekly inflationary supply (1442307692307692307692307) added before supply decay begins.
Constant one-week duration that must pass between mint events; divisor in weeksSinceLastIssuance().
Constant inflation start timestamp (1551830400) used as fallback reference in weeksSinceLastIssuance().
Constant upper bound (200e18) enforced in setMinterReward().
Constant 1.25% weekly decay rate used in tokenDecaySupplyForWeek().
Constant 2.5% annual terminal supply growth rate used in terminalInflationSupply().
Owner address inherited from Owned; gate for allOwner-restricted functions.
Pending owner set by nominateNewOwner() and consumed by acceptOwnership().
Proxy reference in Proxyable, settable by the owner through setProxy().
Cached caller address forwarded through the proxy; written by setMessageSender().
Proxy target Proxyable address in Proxy, settable through setTarget().
Constructor taking owner, last mint event and current week; initialises lastMintEvent and weekCounter.

External view computing total mintable inflationary supply; loops over remaining weeks and calls tokenDecaySupplyForWeek(), terminalInflationSupply(), weeksSinceLastIssuance(), isMintable() and IERC20(periFinanceProxy).totalSupply().
Public pure function computing decaying inflationary supply for a given week counter using powDecimal and multiplyDecimal.
Public pure function computing terminal inflation supply via compound rate over a number of weeks.
Public view computing weeks elapsed since lastMintEvent (or inflation start) using block.timestamp.
Public view returning true if more than MINT_PERIOD_DURATION has elapsed since lastMintEvent.
External onlyPeriFinance function that advances weekCounter and lastMintEvent after a mint event; emits SupplyMinted with block.timestamp.
Owner-only setter for minterReward, bounded by MAX_MINTER_REWARD.
Owner-only setter for the PeriFinance proxy address used in the onlyPeriFinance modifier.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal Proxy(periFinanceProxy).target(); performs an external call to the proxy.
Owner-only setter that updates the Proxyable proxy reference.
External onlyProxy function caching the caller into messageSender.
Two-step ownership transfer acceptance, gated on msg.sender == nominatedOwner.
Owner-only function nominating a new owner address.
Private view enforcing msg.sender == owner for the onlyOwner modifier.
Payable fallback in Proxy that forwards calldata via an assembly call to the target and copies the return data.
Owner-only setter updating the Proxy target.
Caller address used for authorization checks (onlyOwner, onlyPeriFinance, acceptOwnership) and forwarded through the Proxy fallback.
Block timestamp (now) used to compute elapsed weeks, mintability and emitted mint timestamps.
Timestamp-dependent subtraction now.sub(lastMintEvent) (or now.sub(INFLATION_START_DATE)) inside weeksSinceLastIssuance().
Timestamp-dependent comparison now - lastMintEvent > MINT_PERIOD_DURATION inside isMintable().
External call IERC20(periFinanceProxy).totalSupply() inside mintableSupply() whose return value influences minted supply.
External call Proxy(address(periFinanceProxy)).target() inside the onlyPeriFinance modifier used for the access check.
Assembly call(gas, sload(target_slot), ...) inside the Proxy fallback forwarding value and calldata to the target.
_owner address argument of the SupplySchedule constructor.
_lastMintEvent argument of the SupplySchedule constructor.
_currentWeek argument of the SupplySchedule constructor.
counter argument of tokenDecaySupplyForWeek(), the number of decay weeks.
totalSupply argument of terminalInflationSupply().
numOfWeeks argument of terminalInflationSupply().
supplyMinted argument of recordMintEvent(), emitted in the SupplyMinted event.
amount argument of setMinterReward(), bounded by MAX_MINTER_REWARD.
_periFinanceProxy argument of setPeriFinanceProxy().
_owner argument of nominateNewOwner().
_proxy argument of setProxy().
sender argument of setMessageSender().
_target argument of setTarget().
Accumulated mintable amount in mintableSupply().
Loop counter of weeks still to mint in mintableSupply().
Working copy of weekCounter iterated inside mintableSupply().
Weeks since supply decay start computed in mintableSupply() for the decay formula.
Result of IERC20(periFinanceProxy).totalSupply() cached in mintableSupply().
totalSupply plus accumulated totalAmount used as base for terminal inflation in mintableSupply().
Decay factor of tokenDecaySupplyForWeek() derived from DECAY_RATE and powDecimal.
Decaying weekly supply result of tokenDecaySupplyForWeek().
Compound growth rate computed in terminalInflationSupply().
Timedelta in seconds computed in weeksSinceLastIssuance() from block.timestamp.
Weeks issued value computed in recordMintEvent() and added to weekCounter.

edges.reason: Constructor writes lastMintEvent from the _lastMintEvent argument.
Constructor writes weekCounter from the _currentWeek argument.
Constructor of Owned sets the owner state variable.
setMinterReward writes minterReward and is restricted to the owner.
setPeriFinanceProxy writes periFinanceProxy and is restricted to the owner.
recordMintEvent increments weekCounter by the number of weeks issued.
recordMintEvent re-anchors lastMintEvent after a mint.
setProxy writes the proxy state variable and is owner restricted.
setMessageSender writes messageSender and requires the caller to be the proxy.
setTarget writes the Proxy target and is owner restricted.
acceptOwnership transfers owner to the nominated address.
acceptOwnership clears nominatedOwner after acceptance.
nominateNewOwner writes nominatedOwner and is owner restricted.
weeksSinceLastIssuance reads lastMintEvent to derive the elapsed time.
isMintable reads lastMintEvent for its timestamp comparison.
weeksSinceLastIssuance uses INFLATION_START_DATE as the fallback reference.
weeksSinceLastIssuance divides the time difference by MINT_PERIOD_DURATION.
isMintable compares elapsed time against MINT_PERIOD_DURATION.
mintableSupply reads weekCounter as the iteration start week.
mintableSupply adds INITIAL_WEEKLY_SUPPLY for pre-decay weeks.
tokenDecaySupplyForWeek uses DECAY_RATE in the decay expression.
terminalInflationSupply uses TERMINAL_SUPPLY_RATE_ANNUAL in the compound rate.
setMinterReward requires amount <= MAX_MINTER_REWARD.
mintableSupply casts periFinanceProxy to IERC20 for the totalSupply query.
onlyPeriFinance reads periFinanceProxy to resolve the authorised target.
mintableSupply early-returns when isMintable() is false.
mintableSupply calls weeksSinceLastIssuance() to size the loop.
mintableSupply calls tokenDecaySupplyForWeek() inside the decay branch.
mintableSupply calls terminalInflationSupply() in the terminal branch.
recordMintEvent calls weeksSinceLastIssuance() to count issued weeks.
recordMintEvent is gated by the onlyPeriFinance modifier.
setMinterReward is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setPeriFinanceProxy is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setProxy is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
nominateNewOwner is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setTarget is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
_onlyOwner compares the untrusted msg.sender against owner.
acceptOwnership compares the untrusted msg.sender against nominatedOwner.
onlyPeriFinance authorises based on the untrusted msg.sender.
Proxy fallback forwards the untrusted msg.sender into setMessageSender.
weeksSinceLastIssuance depends on block.timestamp to compute elapsed weeks.
isMintable depends on block.timestamp for its period check.
recordMintEvent emits and stores a value derived from block.timestamp.
block.timestamp feeds the now.sub(...) operation in weeksSinceLastIssuance.
block.timestamp feeds the now - lastMintEvent comparison in isMintable.
The unsafe timestamp subtraction is performed inside weeksSinceLastIssuance.
The unsafe timestamp comparison is performed inside isMintable.
lastMintEvent-derived weekCounter affects the timestamp arithmetic in weeksSinceLastIssuance.
weekCounter maintenance directly determines the mintable period check.
mintableSupply performs the external totalSupply call on the PeriFinance proxy.
periFinanceProxy is the target address of the external totalSupply call.
The external totalSupply result flows back into the mintableSupply computation.
onlyPeriFinance performs the external Proxy.target() call as its authorization check.
periFinanceProxy is the address queried by the Proxy.target() external call.
Proxy fallback executes an external assembly call to the target with forwarded gas and value, enabling reentrancy.
_owner parameter flows into the constructor and Owned base constructor.
_lastMintEvent parameter flows into the constructor state assignment.
_currentWeek parameter flows into the constructor weekCounter assignment.
counter parameter drives the exponent in tokenDecaySupplyForWeek.
totalSupply parameter is the base of the terminal inflation computation.
numOfWeeks parameter drives the compound exponent in terminalInflationSupply.
supplyMinted parameter is emitted in the SupplyMinted event.
amount parameter is validated and written to minterReward in setMinterReward.
_periFinanceProxy parameter is validated and written in setPeriFinanceProxy.
_owner parameter is written to nominatedOwner in nominateNewOwner.
_proxy parameter is written to the proxy state variable in setProxy.
sender parameter is written to messageSender in setMessageSender.
_target parameter is written to the Proxy target in setTarget.
totalAmount accumulates the mintable amount inside mintableSupply.
remainingWeeksToMint drives the while loop in mintableSupply.
currentWeek tracks the iterated week inside mintableSupply.
decayCount is computed and passed to the decay branch of mintableSupply.
totalSupply local caches the external totalSupply result inside mintableSupply.
currentTotalSupply is the base for terminal inflation inside mintableSupply.
effectiveDecay is the base of the decay computation in tokenDecaySupplyForWeek.
supplyForWeek is the returned decaying supply of tokenDecaySupplyForWeek.
effectiveCompoundRate drives the terminal inflation result.
timeDiff holds the timestamp-derived delta in weeksSinceLastIssuance.
numberOfWeeksIssued is added to weekCounter in recordMintEvent.
